boundary.zh: Notion 当前版本化公共 API（Notion-Version 2026-03-11），覆盖页面、块、数据源/数据库、评论、文件上传、视图、用户、搜索、异步任务、OAuth 与 webhook 事件。完整边界为官方文档站 openapi.json 快照中的 49 个 Endpoint；Undocumented 内部 API（tag=Internal）与独立 Admin API（独立 /admin server）不进入本产品边界。
boundary.en: The current versioned Notion public API (Notion-Version 2026-03-11) covering pages, blocks, data sources/databases, comments, file uploads, views, users, search, async tasks, OAuth, and webhook events. The complete boundary is the 49 endpoints in the official docs-site openapi.json snapshot; the undocumented internal API (tag=Internal) and the separate Admin API (separate /admin server) are not part of this product.

contractSource.license: reviewed: mutable docs-site document with no file-level license; Notion Developer Terms 3.1(a) prohibits redistributing API materials, so the OAS is imported once and never retained (provenance records the pinned SHA-256)

qualityAudit.i18n: 5/5 (validated; evaluator flags translated disabledReason as structural, same baseline as shipped products)
qualityAudit.knownFindings: leaf examples on nullable oneOf branches and a small set of const-only fields; request-examples bodies for create-database verified valid against curated schemas

blockers.zh: 尚未生成、测试并发布 @pontx/notion 与 pontx-notion。完整候选契约已定型（49 Endpoint / 523 Schema，静态质量 49.81/50），下一步是在独立 SDK 仓库生成 SDK/CLI、通过 Node 18/20/22 CI 与 registry 复验，然后进入 metadata 准入、Preview、Production 与生产验收。
blockers.en: @pontx/notion and pontx-notion have not been generated, tested, and published yet. The complete candidate contract is finalized (49 Endpoints / 523 Schemas, static quality 49.81/50); the next step is generating the SDK/CLI in a dedicated SDK repository, passing Node 18/20/22 CI and registry verification, then metadata admission, Preview, Production, and production acceptance.

nextAction.zh: 在独立仓库生成 @pontx/notion SDK/CLI（从固定 PontxSpec 镜像生成），通过全部质量门与 registry 复验后发布；随后把 sdk.json 置为 published、将产品移入 products/ 与 catalog，走 Preview/Production 与生产验收。
nextAction.en: Generate the @pontx/notion SDK/CLI in a dedicated repository (generated from the pinned PontxSpec mirror), pass all quality gates and registry verification, publish it, then set sdk.json to published, move the product into products/ and the catalog, and run Preview/Production with production acceptance.
